Surat and Mumbai's jewellers got hit with a 67% hallmarking fee overnight, from Rs45 to Rs75 an article, right as the festive buying season opens.

સુરત અને મુંબઈના ઝવેરીઓ પર રાતોરાત ૬૭% હૉલમાર્કિંગ ફી વધારો ઝીંકાયો, ₹૪૫થી ₹૭૫ પ્રતિ ટુકડો.

BIS (Hallmarking) Amendment Regulations, 2026, notified 14 September, set gold hallmarking at Rs75 per article, Rs200 minimum per consignment; silver stays at Rs35. GJC's Rajesh Rokde and Avinash Gupta want it rolled back, calling the flat charge harder on lightweight jewellery.

Bureau of Indian Standards, 14 September; GJC statement via Free Press Journal.

Surat and Mumbai priced gold at 13,373 rupees a gram today, up 1.54% on the desk's own last print, as the metal itself climbed.

સુરત અને મુંબઈમાં આજે સોનું પ્રતિ ગ્રામ ₹૧૩,૩૭૩ — ધાતુના ભાવ વધારાથી ૧.૫૪% ઊંચું.

Silver rose too, up 2.45% to 1,98,966 rupees a kilogram. From today's tape reading — gold $4,329.30/oz, silver $64.41/oz, an intraday board, not yet a settled close — and USD/INR 96.08.

Carat Capital tape, 16 September (intraday reading); USD/INR via xe.com, cross-checked against Wise.
